name: Quaestor AAPL curve (demo)
description: A devnet demonstration of a Meteora Dynamic Bonding Curve anchored to the price of Apple Inc. shares. It is not a share and not a claim on one: it confers no ownership, dividend, voting or redemption right, and it has no value. It exists to show a launch curve designed for tokenized stocks, where the fair price is already known. Built by Quaestor, which is not affiliated with Apple Inc.
